Ivy (CSOps): flagging an incident - auto-archive playbook ran and archived ~48 accounts that had recent activity. found in the run logs: some contacts got stale_contact=true incorrectly.
Ben (Data): can you paste an example log?
Ivy (CSOps): ```
2026-04-10T09:05:12Z event=stale_check acct=AC-7721 last_activity=2026-04-08 stale_contact=true
2026-04-10T09:05:13Z playbook=auto-archive action=archive acct=AC-7721 reason=stale_contact
```
Rosa (Playbooks): auto-archive should only consider last_activity > 30d. looks like the stale detection query compared local_date vs utc_date and mis-calculated days for accounts in UTC+ zones.
Ben (Data): confirmed. the date_trunc vs timezone conversion bug subtracts whole day for Europe/Asia accounts. quick fix: use at time zone 'UTC' in the query and re-evaluate.
Ken (Support): support tickets show 11 customers reached out—mostly confused. none escalated yet.
AutomationsBot: scheduled dry-run for playbook rollback on staging at 2026-04-10T11:00:00Z (run_id=rb-551) :gear:
Ivy (CSOps): plan: 1) revert archive actions for affected accounts, 2) patch stale-check query to use UTC-normalized timestamps, 3) add regional timezone unit tests. owners: Ben->query patch & backfill list, Rosa->playbook rollback + CI test, Ivy->customer comms + runbook entry. target: rollback + soft restore within 3 hours.
Rosa (Playbooks): performing rollback now. will annotate reactivated accounts with metadata {restore: 'auto-archive-2026-04-10', owner:'Ivy'}.
Ben (Data): backfill: found 48 accounts where last_activity >= now() - interval '7 days' but stale_contact=true. exporting list s3://redwood-cs/auto-archive/2026-04-10/restore-48.csv
Ivy (CSOps): restored 47/48; one failed due to manual delete — opened support ticket. emailing AMs with context and adding an alert: auto-archive > 1% change in active bucket.
Rosa (Playbooks): added UTC normalization test to playbook CI; staging dry-run passed.
Ivy (CSOps): closing loop: issue root cause timezone bug in stale detection, patch merged, 47 accounts restored, 1 support ticket open. I'll add retro notes and a permanent monitor for regional date mismatches. thanks all :sparkles:
